passage: For over two centuries, geologists classified Earth's history into distinct chronological epochs based on stratigraphy—the systematic study of rock layers, rock strata, and fossilized organic remains...

questions.question: Which statement best summarizes the main thesis of the passage?
options: A) Traditional geological time scales are flawed because they ignore modern satellite data.
B) Human industrial activity has altered planetary systems so fundamentally that it justifies formalizing the Anthropocene epoch.
C) Nuclear detonations are the sole cause of ocean acidification.
D) Stratigraphers have proven human activity leaves no lasting physical trace.
questions.explanation: 🧠 Logical Framework: Captures the core premise that human activity justifies a new geological epoch.
